propositions.speaker: Buyer
propositions.text: Is this initiative currently a priority for the customer?

propositions.speaker: Buyer
propositions.text: Does our Insight Map accurately represent what the customer needs to achieve from their initiative?

propositions.speaker: Buyer
propositions.text: Are the funds needed for this initiative currently allocated?

propositions.speaker: Buyer
propositions.text: Is there a specific date by which the customer must implement their initiative in order to avoid consequence(s) or receive the anticipated payback?
Has the customer defined the formal decision criteria they will use to evaluate alternatives?
Does the solution address the key players' most important decision criteria?

propositions.speaker: JUDGMENT OPEN: partner directly, or buyer relaying
propositions.text: Does the customer's partner support our solution?

propositions.speaker: Buyer
propositions.text: Do we have a competitive advantage based on the customer's previous favorable experience with us or our solution in a similar project?

propositions.speaker: Buyer, key player
propositions.text: Has a key player confirmed that our solution delivers business value in a way that uniquely differentiates us from the competition?
Is a key player who wants us to win currently supporting us and/or advocating on our behalf?
Can someone from our team regularly access an executive-level key player(s)?
Are there intangible, subjective factors we can leverage to influence the key players' decision?

propositions.speaker: Buyer
propositions.text: Is a key player in the inner circle willing and able to influence the outcome in our favor?

propositions.speaker: Seller
propositions.text: Can we mitigate any known risk(s) to deliver a successful implementation of our solution?

propositions.speaker: Seller
propositions.text: Is our company able to align, or adapt, to the customer's business culture?

propositions.speaker: Seller
propositions.text: Does the revenue from this opportunity meet the requirements of our business?

propositions.speaker: Seller / leadership
propositions.text: Will winning this opportunity provide our company strategic growth through increased brand recognition, market share, and/or future revenue?
Why Act: We have conducted discovery and understand of the decision maker's goal(s) and pressure(s) driving the initiative.

propositions.speaker: Buyer
propositions.text: Customer Insights: We have reviewed and validated our insight map, including metrics where possible, with each of the customer's key players.
propositions.note: qty modifier: quantified over the map's key players

propositions.text: Decision Criteria: The customer has defined the criteria they will use to make their decision.
